jobs.title: Wiss. Mitarbeiter*in (d/m/w) – 65 % Arbeitszeit (Soil Science PhD, ROOT-DECAY)
jobs.reason: Although this is a funded PhD position, it requires as an essential a completed Master's in soil science, geoecology, agricultural science or a closely related field — a qualification the candidate does not hold and cannot substitute with an IR degree. The subject matter (soil biogeochemistry, root-pore interactions, carbon dynamics) is entirely outside the candidate's field and skills.

jobs.title: Wiss. Mitarbeiter*in (d/m/w) – SFB 1265 "Re-Figuration von Räumen"
jobs.reason: A salaried research post requiring only a completed Master's, so the candidate is eligible and it is entry-level by field standards; however, the essential profile (archive theory, multimodal/interdisciplinary archives, graphic/visualisation tools, spatial sociology) is a substantial skills mismatch and the topic sits well outside the candidate's international-law / atrocity-prevention / geopolitical-risk zones. The German is a strength but the specialised archival-sociology focus makes this a weak fit despite eligibility.

jobs.title: Wiss. Mitarbeiter*in (d/m/w) – Cart2Former
jobs.reason: This is a deep-technical AI/deep-learning research post whose essential requirements — a Master's in geodesy/informatics/data science, hands-on experience with neural networks, and proficiency in PyTorch/TensorFlow — go far beyond the candidate's analysis-level Python. It is in geoinformatics/ML, entirely outside the candidate's fields and skill set.

jobs.title: Wiss. Mitarbeiter*in (d/m/w) - PostDoc
jobs.reason: Ineligible: this postdoc requires an already-completed PhD (Promotion) in mechanical/aerospace engineering or physics, which the candidate does not hold. It is also a deep-technical laser-diagnostics engineering role entirely outside the candidate's field and skill set.

jobs.title: Wiss. Mitarbeiter*in (d/m/w)
jobs.reason: Requires an engineering Master's specialised in fluid mechanics plus proven C++ programming and QBlade aero-elastic simulation skills — technical essentials the candidate's IR background and analysis-level Python cannot meet. The topic (wind-turbine ship aerodynamics) is entirely outside the candidate's field.

jobs.title: Wiss. Mitarbeiter*in (d/m/w) - 1. Qualifizierungsphase (zur Promotion)
jobs.reason: The essential requirements — a Master's in civil/environmental engineering or computer science, plus data science, statistical/ML modelling, and strong Python programming — are a deep-technical fit the candidate's analysis-level Python and social-science background cannot meet. It is also entirely outside the candidate's interest zones (urban water systems).

jobs.title: Civil Peace Service (CPS) Advisor (m/f/d) for Dealing with the Past and University partnerships
jobs.reason: Requires business-fluent French as an essential, which exceeds the candidate's B1 level, and demands at least two years of professional experience working directly with universities that RA/student-assistant work does not meet. The dealing-with-the-past and colonial-legacies focus is a strong interest match, but both the language and experience requirements are unmet essentials.
jobs.salary: Not specified (basic subsistence allowance plus expatriate/family allowances)

jobs.title: Solution Architect Travel (w/m/d) für das IVZ
jobs.reason: This is a specialist IT/SAP solution-architect role requiring a completed informatics degree and several years' hands-on Cytric/SAP experience, which the candidate plainly lacks. It is neither entry-level nor in any interest zone, and the essential technical experience is an unmet requirement.
jobs.location: Potsdam or Köln (also Leipzig, Hamburg, München, Frankfurt)

jobs.title: Mitarbeiter*innen im Telemarketing (d/w/m)
jobs.reason: This is a telemarketing / fundraising call role offered explicitly as part-time or Werkstudent, and it is a customer-service function with no research or policy content. It is neither on-level for the candidate's profile nor in any interest zone, and the Werkstudent framing plus non-research nature make it a poor fit.
